name: std-version-history
description: std-version-history — wiki/CMS revision history with diff + rollback. Browses revisions; opens detail in `viewing_single`; compares the opened revision with the newest in `comparing`; Rollback emits RevisionRolledBack { row } for the consumer to restore onto its source document. `RevisionManage` is a rebindable single-entity trait: a consumer rebinds it to its own entity via `linkedEntity`. `config.scopeField` names the Revision field holding the parent document id; a page-mounted `{id}` route param scopes INIT's own fetch, and a consumer forwards SHOW_HISTORY { key } (via a `listens` override) to rescope the feed to one document — empty scopeField (default) or no id keeps today's unfiltered global feed. Rollback and retry refetches stay scoped.

fields.description: Unique identifier for the associated document.
fields.name: documentId

fields.description: Specifies the kind of document this revision belongs to.
fields.name: documentType

fields.description: A sequential identifier representing the revision's order.
fields.name: versionNumber

fields.description: Unique identifier for the user who made the change.
fields.name: authorId

fields.description: The name of the user who made the change.
fields.name: authorName

fields.description: The snapshotted body of the revision — plain text or the rich-text HTML a document-look record carries. Rollback emits RevisionRolledBack { row }; the consumer restores row.content onto its source document.
fields.name: content

fields.description: A brief explanation of the revision's changes.
fields.name: summary

fields.description: The current search query the user submitted.
fields.name: searchTerm

fields.description: The parent document id the feed is currently scoped to, set by SHOW_HISTORY. Empty when browsing the unfiltered global feed.
fields.name: scopeKey

fields.description: The loaded revisions, newest first — what Compare diffs against.
fields.name: revisions

itemActions.description: Actions offered on each row; give an item `roles` to show it only to those viewer roles.
itemActions.label: Row actions

itemClickEvent.description: Event emitted when a row is clicked; opens the revision. Empty disables the row click.
itemClickEvent.label: Row click

scopeField.description: Revision entity field holding the parent document's id. When set, a page-mounted {id} route param scopes INIT's fetch, and a SHOW_HISTORY { key } event rescopes the feed, to rows whose scopeField equals the id/key; rollback and retry refetches stay scoped too. Empty (default) or no id = unfiltered global feed, unchanged from prior behavior.
scopeField.label: Scope field

viewerRole.description: The signed-in viewer's role that each action's `roles` is checked against. Bind it explicitly at the call site (e.g. `viewerRole: @user.role`) in an app whose identity carries a role; left empty, only actions with no `roles` show.
viewerRole.label: Viewer's role
